records.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a full-frame cinematic still for an original calm Japanese future-neighborhood film. Render a single 16:9 landscape image, ideally 2048 x 1152, no borders, no collage.
World: Tsugimachi (継町), an invented inland Japanese town in the year 2080. Society kept advancing technologically and chose to keep repairing its much-loved Showa-era buildings, appliances and habits. This is a living, functioning town, cared for despite visible age. The streets are attached to solid ground in a green valley. Dense, irregularly renovated low and mid-rise blocks, narrow passages, verandas, utility pipes and planted roof terraces create many overlapping layers. It is an optimistic, quiet ordinary weekday, not a disaster or abandoned city.
Visual language: a convincingly photographed location, cinematic naturalism, tactile miniature details without looking like a miniature. Pronounced foreground / middle ground / distant spatial depth. In focus across most of the scene, around an f/8 look, realistic 28–35 mm perspective with straight structural lines. Irregular practical props clustered around a clear visual path. Rich cobalt and cyan daylight, naturally saturated green plants, aged honey-brown wood, faded celadon enamel, cream plaster, restrained rusty ochre. Directional light and believable soft reflected fill; protect the white highlights, retain shadow detail. Real wood grain, worn touch points, repaired chipped paint, oxidized screws, imperfect rippled glass, woven cloth, small water stains specific to their locations. Old does not mean uniformly filthy. Fine photographic texture, no visible brushwork, no anime outlines, no waxy CGI, no oversharpened HDR.
Technology is visibly advanced but quietly useful: small precise ceramic modules and amber indicators integrated into old housings, never neon spectacle. Show at least one clearly identifiable future function in each scene. Humans, when present, are incidental and shown from behind or distant, never a presenting host or a central close-up face.
Do not recreate any particular existing shot. New location, arrangement, objects, characters and camera position. No enormous inhabited tree, floating island, sea-level-disaster premise, water-running tram, schoolgirl at an open high-rise window, or copied shop names. No trademarked characters, brand logos, fantasy glyphs, captions, watermark or explanatory overlay. Keep any specifically requested Japanese sign short, legible and physically part of the scene.

Specific scene:
A sunlit shopping lane in Tsugimachi at 10:40 on a clear late-summer day. Camera at adult standing height, looking diagonally from under a patched cream canvas awning into a gently bending lane. Foreground left: a real vegetable stand with wooden crates, a brass analog scale, handwritten small price tags turned away, radishes with imperfect leaves, a chipped pale-jade tile counter. Middle ground right: an old narrow general store with a genuinely useful future neighborhood delivery station: one cream enamel autonomous cart with visible wheels, sensors and a carried wicker basket, docked beside an enclosed transparent goods lift with one crate inside. The lift has a believable frame and rails fixed to the building, connected to a narrow overhead parcel conduit above shopfront height. Pedestrians have a clear unobstructed path.
The buildings behind step up the valley in several interleaved rows of 4–9 story old concrete and timber infill, with balconies, laundry, ladders, modest roof greenhouses and plants. Keep sky gaps and a small glimpse of distant green hillside, no ocean, no monumental symmetrical tower. Two small adult residents seen from behind carrying shopping baskets. Bright blue sky with a large detailed white cumulus cloud; sunlight from upper left, shaded awning foreground, cool air-perspective distance. One large weathered shop sign reads exactly "継町商店街"; a small readable e-paper date on the delivery station reads exactly "2080.08.24". Dense delightful detail, but a readable central subject and practical scale.

Specific scene:
An intimate medium-wide view from the threshold of a small electronics repair shop at 11:10, daylight entering from camera-left through old wood-framed windows. The central subject is an ordinary 1960s pale-celadon metal desk fan being repaired on a heavily used timber bench. A compact, precise ivory ceramic robotic repair arm, bolted to the bench and visibly connected to an old brass control box, holds a tiny replacement motor bearing while ordinary screwdrivers, labeled component drawers, a cloth, worn soldering station and a glass parts jar surround it. The robotic arm is physically coherent with a few clear joints, no extra tangled manipulators. A middle-aged worker in a faded work jacket sits at the far side, seen from the back/three-quarter back, face not visible, with relaxed posture.
Through the side doorway, a thin slice of the same dense planted market lane and a cream delivery cart outside. One small rectangular physical repair slip clipped next to the fan reads exactly "修理完了 2080.08.24"; a wood board over the drawers reads exactly "継町電器". The old fan occupies a quarter of the image, the workshop feels used yet organized by work. Warm bounced light on wood and skin, blue daylight at the doorway. Exceptional differentiated metal, dust at edges, solder wire and fabric detail. No giant gear, no ship interior, no bicycle repair composition.

Specific scene:
A quiet Tsugimachi back lane just after a late-afternoon shower, early blue hour around 18:35. Low camera around 1.2 m from inside a dry shelter looking down an offset bend toward the warm side entrance of a modest Showa public bath. No people bathing. Weathered square cream and blue-green tiles, curved frosted glass, red-brown wood doors, a linen noren, amber tungsten bulbs, stacked wooden wash buckets under cover, a single old bicycle parked properly and two pairs of sandals.
A cared-for, unusually advanced closed water-recycling installation is integrated into the building on the near right: two elegant transparent water columns with visible clean tubing and ceramic membrane cartridges, mounted into patched copper service pipes, a tiny amber status indicator and an e-paper service date reading exactly "2080.08.24". Pipe connections are continuous and mechanically plausible, no random hose tangles. The mechanism has a distinct quiet practical future identity while the surrounding bath keeps its old character.
One distant adult from behind holding a closed umbrella walks home. Layered balconies and a planted service deck cross the far distance, clearly supported by the buildings. Wet stone has small irregular shallow puddles and broken warm reflections, with a cool slate-blue sky gap, not mirror-polished flooding. Steam only as a very small plume at a vent. The entrance sign reads exactly "継の湯". No nightlife hostesses, no lightning spectacle, no dramatic fog, no neon wash.

Specific scene:
A summer afternoon at 15:20 in a communal rooftop garden of a 1970s Japanese housing block that is still inhabited in 2080. A photographic view from just behind an open wooden utility-room door, with a worn terracotta watering can, an enamel basin, old garden tools and a soft cloth in the shaded near foreground. Midground: handmade wooden vegetable beds, real uneven tomato plants with ties and mixed ripe fruit, two mismatched stools, laundry swaying between proper posts, a simple small table with tea glasses. Keep a traversable human path and safe waist-high perimeter railings.
Future function: thin self-adjusting translucent solar canopy strips in a lightweight, clearly braced frame, each with subtle visible hinge and actuator, shading only part of the beds; a neat narrow nutrient-water channel and palm-sized maintenance crawler on a fixed guide rail. These details must be visible and materially sophisticated, not a common modern solar panel pasted on a retro scene. Old and new hardware have different degrees of weathering. A faded enamel wall calendar at the doorway reads exactly "2080年 8月".
Beyond, several overlapping 6–10 story patched residential blocks step down toward an inland canal and distant green hills, no sea or floating city. Clear cobalt sky and white clouds, realistic deep afternoon shadows, glowing green leaf transmission. One small adult gardener turned away in the distance. Realistic location photography, not a landscape painting, not a bird's-eye panorama.
